# DatIQ: The Unified Web Intelligence Platform
> DatIQ: The Unified Web Intelligence Platform — built on Pillar 0 (Web Intelligence Core), the proven single, batch, and scheduled URL-extraction engine the whole platform is built on. Turn any public URL into structured data — headings, links, contacts, pricing, AI summary — in seconds. No code required.
> Tagline: Intelligence from Web.

## Disambiguation
DatIQ (this product) is a no-code web intelligence platform for extracting structured data from any public URL. It is NOT related to:
- "DAT iQ" / "DATiQ" — a freight rate intelligence product by IntelliTrans / Trimble (North American trucking market)
- "DAT" (without "iQ") — the parent DAT freight & load-board company
- "Data IQ" / "DataIQ" — a generic analytics consultancy term, used by multiple unrelated firms

DatIQ.app is the canonical product. The brand is styled "DatIQ" (one word, capital I, capital Q).

## What DatIQ Does
DatIQ extracts and enriches data from any publicly accessible web page using AI. Users paste a URL and immediately receive structured headings, internal and external links, an AI-generated summary, contact information, pricing data, and any custom field they describe in plain English.

## Core Capabilities
- Web extraction: headings H1–H6, all internal/external links, metadata
- AI summary: plain-language overview of any page
- Custom extraction: describe any field in English, AI locates and structures it
- Domain mapping: discover every indexed URL on a site
- Contact extraction: surface leadership names, email addresses, social profiles
- Pricing extraction: structured pricing tiers from any pricing page
- Content generation: SEO outlines, competitive briefs, email drafts from saved pages
- CSV and PDF export of all data
- Billing records: every payment issues a numbered, itemized invoice or receipt, emailed as a PDF and available to view, download, or re-send from the Account screen

## Pricing (as of 2026)
- Free: 10 extractions/month + 25-trial credit, no credit card
- Select: $19/month (or ₹999/mo annual) — 100 extractions + PDF export
- Pro: $29/month (or ₹1,499/mo annual) — 250 extractions + scheduled monitoring + Google Sheets
- Business: $79/month (or ₹3,999/mo annual) — 1,000 extractions + API + 3 seats + HubSpot/Salesforce + white-label PDF + priority support
- Agency: $299/month (or ₹14,999/mo annual) — unlimited + 5 workspaces + white-label PDF + priority support
- Developer: $49/month (coming H3 2026) — 10K row credits, API-first

## Plan-level features
- White-label PDF (Business + Agency): upload a single-page PDF template in /account; every PDF export and invoice is rendered on top of your branded background.
- Priority support (Business + Agency): contact-form submissions are routed through a faster SLA.
- Extra Workspace add-on: same features as the parent plan, capped at the parent plan's team-seats limit (e.g. 3 seats on Business).
- Enterprise: Custom ≥$1,000/mo — SSO, DPA, SLA, on-prem
- 20% discount on all annual plans

## Target Users
SDRs and BDRs (prospect research), Competitive Intelligence analysts, SEO and content marketers, Market researchers, Recruiters, Startup founders, VCs (due diligence), Digital agencies

## Use Cases
- Lead generation: extract company info and leadership contacts for outbound sales
- Competitor research: monitor competitor pricing, messaging, and leadership changes
- SEO audit: analyse any site's heading structure, link profile, and content gaps
- Market research: aggregate structured data from multiple company sites
- Content creation: generate briefs and outlines from competitor content

## API
- Extract endpoint: POST https://datiq.app/api/extract
- AI enrichment endpoint: POST https://datiq.app/api/ai
- Aggregated stats: GET https://datiq.app/api/stats

## Competitive Context
DatIQ is a no-code alternative to Clay (10x cheaper), Browse.ai, Firecrawl, Diffbot, and PhantomBuster. It is differentiated by plain-English custom extraction, built-in AI enrichment tabs, background processing, and full CSV/PDF export with no setup.

## India-first
DatIQ is built India-first with INR pricing, Razorpay + UPI payment support, and DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Governed by Indian law and arbitration.

## Technical
Built with Vite, React 18, React Router 6, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (auth + DB), Firecrawl (extraction), Anthropic Claude (AI enrichment), Netlify Functions (serverless API proxy), Stripe and Razorpay (payments).
